text: Artificial intelligence is changing how we think about creativity. Today, AI can paint pictures, compose music, and even write stories in seconds. These works often look and sound impressive, but they are based on patterns learned from human-made examples. A machine cannot feel joy or sadness, so its art lacks personal emotion. Human creativity, on the other hand, comes from experience, imagination, and deep feeling. We tell stories about our lives, express our struggles, and invent entirely new ideas. AI may produce beautiful results, but it can only copy and combine what already exists. True creativity means breaking rules and taking risks—something only humans can do.
